resources.string: Keeps Capsule Lite running. When you turn on navigation info, it reads only the Google Maps screen, to show ETA and next turn. It never reads other apps or your input.

• Swiping down on a companion pill expands the activity shown in that pill. • Notification selection clears stale activity focus so notifications open in their own expanded view. • The main pill continues to use its configured swipe-down action.
